en: When Congress passes a bill, the President may veto it, but legislators can override this veto if two-thirds of both houses vote in favor.

When the Supreme Court declares a law unconstitutional, that law becomes void and unenforceable, effectively striking it down from the Philippine legal system.
The Ifugao build stone-walled rice terraces along mountain contours, which slows down water runoff and prevents soil erosion during heavy tropical rains.
Dr. Fe del Mundo designed a bamboo incubator that uses hot water bottles to regulate temperature, keeping premature babies warm in areas lacking electricity.

When a Filipino citizen turns eighteen and registers, they gain the right to vote, which allows them to elect their local and national government leaders.

By pooling their savings in a cooperative, Filipino farmers secure low-interest loans, which funds their planting season and increases their overall harvest profit.

Philippine voters elect the President and Vice President separately through plurality voting, which sometimes results in the two winners belonging to different political parties.
